about: one condition per comparison, on fields and on columns
sql: SELECT o.id FROM objects o WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) = ? AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) IS NOT ? AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) < ? AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) <= ? AND o.created_at > ? AND o.updated_at >= ? AND instr(lower(o.title), lower(?)) > 0 AND substr(lower(o.summary), 1, length(?)) = lower(?) AND (json_extract(o.props_json, ?) IS NULL OR json_extract(o.props_json, ?) = '') AND (json_extract(o.props_json, ?) IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) != '') AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(json_extract(o.props_json, ?)) WHERE value = ?) AND json_extract(o.props_json, ?) = ? ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
